title: Multilingual content framework
objective: Localize the opportunity-centre task flow in English, Hindi and Tamil while preserving source-truth and control labels.
apiContracts: question payload sends language code en/hi/ta to AI gateway.
guardrails: This is UI-level localization for this feature, not a claim that every official source is translated. Source text may remain in its original language.
exitCriteria: Core controls, status, warnings and empty/error states remain understandable after changing language.
prototypeBoundary: This phase uses the Phase 09–17 prototype contracts. Database persistence and production auth are not claimed.
